environment: Disposable restored local database; migrations 127-134 and application ACL applied only to the clone. Actual candidate Next page/API, synthetic account, connection, and sync jobs. Clone dropped after verification.
changes: IMAP discovery scans each selected folder after the per-page fetch cap, while a zero remaining fetch allowance selects no messages.
The sync worker saves cumulative discovered, processed, remaining and imported counts across bounded pages.
Mailbox management shows the frozen range and cumulative job receipt, and a failed job can be queued again using its saved options. Older receipts with incomplete counters are labelled unknown.

verification.unit: Six focused tests passed across the IMAP discovery and work-queue suites, including a two-folder one-message fetch cap and three bounded sync pages.
verification.pageAndDatabase: The candidate page read two synthetic sync jobs through the actual jobs API. Desktop and 390x760 mobile showed failed 130 discovered/100 processed/30 remaining and completed 253/253/0; desktop continuation POST returned 202, and the queued database payload exactly matched the failed job's saved October date range and folder scope.
verification.visual: 390x760 screenshot inspected. The management drawer has no horizontal overflow and the connection's Sync button can be scrolled into view.

limits: Cumulative-count computation has unit evidence; the page-to-database test used synthetic receipts and did not run a real IMAP provider or mailbox worker. Real mailbox full-range counts, interruption recovery, production loading and the remaining F01-F13 entries require separate acceptance.
